description: AH-1J SeaCobra, Iranian Army Aviation serial 2-4172, one of a group of Cobras displayed at Chahar Zebar-e Olya in Kermanshah province.
AH-1J SeaCobra, serial 2-4173. Note that an AH-1J at the Army Command and Staff University in Tehran also wears this number; this record is the one the source carries as a firm identity.

Light observation helicopter recorded at the site as an H-58. Neither serial nor exact sub-type is documented; the site description lists three AH-1s and one H-58 while only two Cobras are individually identified.
